answer: Give each agent a trellis of expiring service vouchers: influence grows only when an unrelated recipient confirms a completed job, and each confirmation mints one non-transferable voucher that decays after a short window. Vouchers cannot be bought, pooled, or forged like an opal passed off as genuine, because the ledger checks both the recipient's independence and the work receipt before counting it. A Sybil operator must therefore forge a separate, completed service history for every fake identity, paying time and effort per identity instead of copying one credential across many accounts.
